findings.text: Biggest gain: T11, +0.41 s for PIA L43 over LAW L43. Brakes 14 m later, carries 13 km/h more minimum speed, gets on the throttle 7 m later.
Gain #2: T8-T9 straight, +0.30 s for LAW L43 over PIA L43. Reaches 21 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #3: T10-T11 straight, +0.20 s for LAW L43 over PIA L43. Reaches 14 km/h higher top speed.
Gain #4: T3, +0.17 s for LAW L43 over PIA L43. Brakes 8 m later, gets on the throttle 8 m earlier.
Gain #5: T1, +0.14 s for PIA L43 over LAW L43. Brakes 10 m earlier, carries 2 km/h less minimum speed, exits 10 km/h slower.
